stories.headline: Alibaba Cloud plans six-year stroll to 20GW of datacenters, reveals chip to power them
stories.summary: Alibaba Cloud has announced plans to expand its datacenter capacity to 20 gigawatts over the next six years. Alongside this infrastructure expansion, the company revealed a new custom chip designed to power these facilities. CEO Eddie Wu emphasized the long-term potential of AI, comparing its current state to the early days of electricity and predicting that machine cognition will eventually drive the vast majority of intellectual work.
